signals.text: Object: the claim that the legend "Amber Viaduct was launched" on the Umber Channel instrument diagram has a dotted underline. I withdraw the Object. The disputed attribute is the underline of that printed legend.
Diagram owner: Umber Channel
Amber Viaduct was launched.

Object: the claim that Amber Viaduct was launched, described by a legend on the Umber Channel instrument diagram. I withdraw the Object. The disputed assertion is the event, not the underline of its printed legend.
Diagram owner: Umber Channel
Amber Viaduct was launched.
